messages.content: For user traveler_01, please check the weather in Tokyo and convert 22°C to Fahrenheit, then look up the status of flight AA100. After that, scan the devices in the living_room, find the smart lock with lock_id lock_main, and lock it using PIN 2026. Then check the current state of the living room light with device ID light_living and dim it to 20% brightness. Also set the living room AC with device_id ac_living to 22. Finally, send me a high-priority app alert that says: “Departure routine completed: flight checked, doors locked, lights dimmed, and AC adjusted.”
